name: Docket Billing
office_task: When a job is marked complete, turn its signed site dockets of hours, plant and materials into one draft Xero invoice at our rates, park what it can't bill, and hold it for a named person.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id and holds the site dockets filed against it as job lines (ServiceM8, Simpro, or a job sheet)
Xero, which issues the invoice_id and holds the schedule of rates as Items

emits.write: One draft invoice in Xero per completed job, referenced job:<id> (and the stage under a building contract), every line a line off a site docket filed on the job with its docket number in the notes, every rate read from the schedule of rates at draft time, and each signed daywork docket attached as evidence. A second completion event updates the same draft.
emits.readback: Xero returns the InvoiceID; GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} must return the invoice with Reference job:<id>, and that id is stamped on the job as seam.invoice_id. No id back is not a write: it raises invoice.write_failed and the run stops.

emits.write: The invoice leaves only after a release naming the accounts person, or naming the rule they set and showing the total is under its threshold; the release and the send time are recorded against the job.
emits.readback: GET /api.xro/2.0/Invoices/{InvoiceID} returns it AUTHORISED and sent to the contact, and the job read by its id shows seam.released_by (a person or a rule) before the send time. A send with no release on the record is refused.

emits.write: A parked or waiting invoice as an exception on the job: the reason from the standard's fixed list (not_in_pricebook, unsigned_variation, write_failed) or over_threshold, the job id, the invoice id, the docket numbers and codes left unpriced, and exception_owner set to the person the business named for billing.
emits.readback: The exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the job_id, the invoice_id, the reason and the exception_owner; the next run reads it there and stops until exception.closed.
